author: Justin Goodrum
title: Turtle Beach Rematch Advanced: A Smart Upgrade From Entry-Level Controllers - NewsBreak
text:
By Justin Goodrum ,
3 hours ago
Turtle Beach’s Rematch Advanced Wired Controller pairs an ergonomic design with a strong feature set, helping it stand out among other wired options. Available in cotton candy, blue kitsune, Kyoto Bloom, and dark cosmos colorways, it brings both style and substance.
With app-based customization and a competitive $39.99 price tag, the Rematch Advanced is a smart choice for gamers looking to move a step up from entry-level controllers without breaking the bank.
What’s in the Box The package comes with the Turtle Beach Rematch Advanced Wired Controller, a detachable 8ft / 2.5m USB-C Cable, and a quick start insert.
Feature Set One standout feature of this controller is its glow-in-the-dark design, which activates after absorbing UV light. It also includes two-stop hair triggers for more precise control and mappable quick-action back buttons for faster response times. Dual rumble motors power immersive feedback, and the ergonomic design sits comfortably in the hands during extended play.
A less common addition is built-in audio controls on the D-pad, along with a dedicated mic-mute button. Like other Turtle Beach products, the Rematch Advanced connects to the free Control Hub app, allowing users to remap buttons, adjust trigger sensitivity, and fine-tune dead zones.
The controller is officially licensed for Xbox and PC. It’s compatible with Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, and Windows 10 and 11 PCs via an 8-foot USB-C wired connection.
Real Life Testing Gaming across multiple genres feels smooth and responsive with this controller. The triggers react quickly, and the companion app clearly lays out a wide range of customizable options. It’s comfortable to hold, even during long sessions, and doesn’t leave my hands feeling tired.
One drawback: Because the controller works on both Xbox and PC, it would be helpful if settings were saved directly to the controller, regardless of which device is in use.
The glow-in-the-dark feature for certain editions of the controller is a fun addition, but it takes a while to activate and can be inconsistent. Since my office doesn’t get much sunlight, it’s tough to get the effect to work regularly, which is a bummer because the designs look cool.
Final Verdict Overall, the controller packs in plenty of premium features for its price point. As long as you don’t mind adjusting settings depending on the device you’re using, the Rematch Advanced stands out as a stylish controller that delivers solid, high-level performance.
Positives:
The app has great features to customize the experience
Controller designs are cool and stand out among their competitors
The controller is comfortable to use
Negatives:
The controller takes a while to charge in the sunlight to attract the UV light to have the glow-in-the-dark effect
Lacking the ability to save the same settings within the controller
